answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the spiral. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the comet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
